summary.headline: Consolidated revenue rose 7% to INR554 crores, but EBITDA fell about INR16 crores as Maldives diesel costs spiked; India grew 16% at INR74 crores.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 7% YoY to INR554 crores and consolidated EBITDA was INR205 crores at a 37% margin. The decline in EBITDA was attributed almost entirely to Maldives fuel and ancillary costs, which rose to INR38 crores from INR19 crores as diesel prices roughly doubled from pre-war levels in April-May. India delivered 13% revenue growth and 16% EBITDA growth, with occupancy and ADR both up. Reported PAT of INR124 crores was inflated by a INR102 crore deferred tax reversal following the tax regime switch.

financial_highlights.change: YoY decline of about INR16 crores
Broadly flat; about 3% growth adjusted for one-off transaction costs
Includes INR102 crore net deferred tax liability reversal from tax regime change; tax rate cut from 34.94% to 25.17%

financial_highlights.value: INR2,095 crores (India INR1,329 crores; Maldives USD81 million / INR766 crores)

segments.name: India hospitality
segments.commentary: Revenue INR203 crores (+13%) and EBITDA INR74 crores (+16%); occupancy rose about 7% to 67% and ADR about 8%, giving RevPAR growth of about 20%. Adjusted for a one-off electricity benefit in the prior year, EBITDA growth would be 18%.

segments.name: Maldives resorts
segments.commentary: Revenue INR218 crores (+5%) but EBITDA INR32 crores (-32%); fuel and ancillary costs rose to INR38 crores from INR19 crores. Excluding the fuel spike, management says EBITDA would have grown about 10%.

segments.name: Annuity (commercial/leased assets)
segments.commentary: Revenue INR128 crores (+3%) and EBITDA INR111 crores at 87% margin; committed occupancy 98%. Narmada Estates in Pune was recently added.

segments.name: Hospitality total
segments.commentary: Hospitality EBITDA declined 4% YoY to INR106 crores; adjusted hospitality EBITDA growth was about 14%.
